official.source: Helsingin Sanomat via Kaleva; Yle News
official.assessment_note: Tuike Finland learned in May 2026 that an environmental impact assessment was required; the clearing (March to August 2026) took place without a completed assessment, and Yle reports the assessments were still incomplete in October 2026.

actions.text: The permit and supervisory agency (LVV) called on Tuike Finland to suspend the work immediately, and at the latest by 23 October 2026.
Oulu police opened a preliminary investigation on suspicion of environmental damage.
